data.description: We need to spawn power ups in all gym scenes. There should be a plugable spawner. The initial implementation will simply pick a power up at random from all those available and place it at a random place on the screen (not on top of enemies). The frequency of spawn will be a configuation in the main game config file (if no such file exists then create a config system).
data.title: Spawn power-ups in all combat gym scenes
